role: The process-wide lock Delete All My Data holds while it runs: archive disk writes run through it and are refused while a purge runs, the purge waits for the writes already in flight, and the CloudKit sync manager reads isPurging before a full sync or an upload.
types: PurgeGate: enum (nonisolated) — static gate state and entry points
PurgeGate.Refused: struct (Error, LocalizedError) — a write refused while a purge runs
PurgeGate.State: struct (private, Sendable) — purges running, writes in flight, purges waiting for them
state: mem:PurgeGate.state (static OSAllocatedUnfairLock<State>: purges, writers, waiting continuations)
toplevel: Type doc: the writers are writeArchiveBytes and SessionArchive.saveIndex (every archive write path reaches the disk through one of them) and CloudKitSyncManager, which checks isPurging; a refused write throws Refused and its caller handles it as any failed write; overlapping purges are counted.

units.does: Localized explanation that the data is being deleted and nothing can be saved until that has finished.
units.entry: LocalizedError.localizedDescription, read wherever a refused write's error is shown or logged

units.does: True while at least one purge holds the gate (purges > 0), read under the lock.

Under the lock: when no purge runs, counts one more write in flight; otherwise logs a warning and throws Refused without running `write`. An admitted write runs `write` and, however it ends, calls finishWrite; returns or rethrows what `write` did.

branches.effect: write runs; finishWrite on every exit

units.does: Under the lock counts one write out; when it was the last in flight, takes the purges waiting for the drain and resumes each after the lock is released.
Closes the gate for one purge (close) and returns at once when no write is in flight; otherwise suspends until the last write in flight resumes it. Paired with one endPurge.

branches.cond: close kept the continuation (writes in flight)
branches.effect: wait for finishWrite; else resume now

units.does: Under the lock counts the purge in; when writes are in flight appends the continuation to the waiting list and returns true, else returns false.
Under the lock counts one purge out (never below zero); writes are admitted again once none runs.
